message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO," with the masthead across the top in large red letters. The central figure is a massive, muscular, gray bull statue. A woman in a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants stands on the left, painting the front half of the bull with bright red paint using a brush. To the right, a man in a light-colored shirt and dark trousers sits on the ground, painting the lower right leg and hoof of the bull with bright green paint.

The bull appears to be made of a smooth, metallic or stone material, and its body is divided into sections of original gray, fresh red, and fresh green. Red paint splatters the white ground beneath the woman, while green paint marks the ground near the man. Two paint cans, one red and one partially obscured, sit on the ground.

Legible text at the top includes "BEREBUT UNIVERSITAS TRISAKTI" and "DAFTAR HITAM PELABUHAN LAUT." Bold black text at the bottom reads "MERAH-HIJAU PILKADA PDIP." Date and price details appear in the bottom right corner above a barcode.
